title: Medico-Legal Case Registration Procedure
content:
SOP: Medico-Legal Case Registration Procedure (SOP-MLC-001)
DEPARTMENT: Medical Records (MRD / HIM)
VERSION: 2.2
ROLES: front_office, doctor, medical_records
PURPOSE: Statutory police intimation within 1 hour for forensic trauma cases.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Medico-Legal Case Registration Procedure in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Medico-Legal Case Registration Procedure in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Medico-Legal Case Registration Procedure in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Medico-Legal Case Registration Procedure in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Medico-Legal Case Registration Procedure in full compliance with Medical Records (MRD / HIM) hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Medical Records (MRD / HIM).
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-MLC-001 Medico-Legal Case Registration Procedure v2.2, Section 4
